conviction_note: Balanced evidence. Consensus Q3 revenue ($247.2m, +3% q/q) sits a little above management's 'roughly flat Q2 to Q3' signal and at the top of what the FY guide plus the >$250m Q4 exit imply. An EPS bar of $0.36-0.37 needs Q3 opex to fall about $60m from Q2's $177m, on a name that fell 11% when Q2 EPS missed $0.41 by $0.36. Against that, TG beat its own quarterly guide in both 2026 quarters, about 19% of float is short with 15 days to cover, and class demand (Kesimpta +22% cc in Q3) held up. p_up 49 on abs 12.5 gives -0.25. The findings sum to +0.1. Both say there is no edge.
bar: Q3 2026 total revenue $247.2m and EPS $0.37 (Earnings Whispers via finviz, 2026-11-02: https://finviz.com/news/413669/tg-therapeutics-tests-briumvi-momentum-against-seasonal-lull-as-stock-nears-breakout). Fiscal AI via Stocktwits, 2026-10-30, gives ~$245m and $0.36 (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/tgtx-stock-hits-fresh-52-week-high-ahead-of-earnings-amid-buyout-buzz/cZULRP2R9cR), so two sources agree. FY26 consensus is ~$947.5m against the company guide of ~$950m total and $890-905m US BRIUMVI (Q2 8-K, 2026-08-03: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001001316/000143774926025304/ex_997107.htm). The sweep row's '$875-900m' is stale (that was the January/Q1 range). The company gave no numeric Q3 guide; management said only 'roughly flat' Q2 to Q3.
positioning_check: Short interest ~30.6M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement, 15.0 days to cover (FINRA via Curved Trading search snippet; the page itself returned 403). Equibles: 29.3M shares, 19.2% of float, 13.6 days, as of 2026-08-19. That is a crowded short. Skew: 25-delta put minus call is +7.61 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.39, ATM IV 83%, event-implied move 11.79%. The stock is 3% off its 52-week high and +121% off the low, +7.9% over 20 days and -2.3% over 5 days. Stocktwits retail sentiment was 'extremely bullish' on 2026-10-30, and an unconfirmed Betaville takeover rumour came out on 2026-08-21. Heavy short interest and a downside-paid skew sit alongside a crowded bullish retail and M&A-hope tape: positioning is two-sided.

findings.finding: Consensus Q3 total revenue is $247.2m (+3% on Q2's $240.3m). That implies US BRIUMVI of ~$234m against Q2's $227.7m. Management said on the Q2 call that seasonality would keep sales roughly flat Q2 to Q3. On the FY US guide ($890-905m, H1 $422.5m) plus the stated >$250m Q4 exit, Q3 US is at most ~$217-232m. So the bar sits at or slightly above the top of what the company signalled. Offsetting this, TG beat its own quarterly guide in both 2026 quarters, by $5-8m (Q1 $194.8m vs $185-190m guide; Q2 $227.7m vs ~$220m). A Q3 US of $232-236m would meet consensus, and with the Q4 exit it would force another FY raise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A revenue beat plus raise has not reliably paid. Q2 2026 (2026-08-03): revenue $240.3m vs $230.8m est, FY raised $925m->$950m, stock -11.3% (on EPS/opex). Q1 2026 (2026-05-06): beat and raise, +16.3%. Q3 2025 (2025-11-03): beat and raise, -3.1%. Q4 2025 (2026-02-26): +4.2%.
findings.why_not_priced: The flat-Q3 remark was on the public call, and the article itself flags the tension, so it is partly priced. If the market had fully priced a flat Q3, consensus would sit near $240m rather than $247m and the stock would not be 3% off its high.
findings.independence: Guide arithmetic from the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001001316/000143774926025304/ex_997107.htm). Beat-own-guide history from the Q1 release summary (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001001316/000143774926015013/ex_926557.htm). The 'flat' quote comes from one secondary source only.

findings.finding: Consensus Q3 EPS is $0.37 (Fiscal AI $0.36) against Q2's $0.05. Q2 missed a $0.41 consensus because R&D included $54.6m of subcutaneous-manufacturing and second-manufacturer charges, and Evercore said the Street was underestimating opex. At a 24% tax rate (Q2 10-Q), ~$16.6m quarterly interest and ~17% cost of revenue, $0.37 needs Q3 R&D+SG&A of roughly $115-120m against Q2's $177.5m and Q1's $136.6m. About $45m of the ~$100m FY manufacturing charge is still to come in H2. The FY opex guide ($350-400m ex non-cash comp, plus $100m) does allow H2 quarters of roughly $100-125m, so the bar is reachable only if Q3 carries little of the remaining charge.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: EPS $0.05 vs $0.41 on opex, -11.3% despite a revenue beat and raise; reports put the intraday low at -13% to -16%. This is the line that moved the stock last time.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar has risen from $0.05 to $0.37 on the assumption that the manufacturing charges roll off. The company gave no quarterly split of the remaining ~$45m. If the market doubted the bar, the whisper ($0.44) would not sit above consensus and the bearish reading would not have fallen from 25.9% to 9.4%. Still, this is inference from guidance arithmetic, not a company number.
findings.independence: The Q2 miss and its cause are in the Zacks/Evercore coverage (https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/2966731/tgtx-q2-earnings-lag-sales-rise-yy-2026-view-raised-stock-down). The opex guide is in the Q2 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001001316/000143774926025304/ex_997107.htm). The whisper and bar come from the finviz/EW 2026-11-02 article. All are the company's own documents plus one preview.

findings.finding: Short interest is ~30.6M shares (~19-20% of float) with 15 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement, up from 29.3M (19.2%, 13.6 days) on 2026-08-19. The stock has climbed to a 52-week high since then, so those shorts are under water going into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Short interest was similar (23.6M, 10.8 days) at the 2025-09-30 settlement. The four 2026 reactions were -11.3, +16.3, +4.2 and -3.1: up moves are not muted, and the +16.3% in May came on a clean beat and raise.
findings.source_date: 2026-08-19 (settlement); 2026-09-30 figure via Curved Trading/FINRA search snippet, snippet_only
findings.why_not_priced: Short interest is public, but it is not in the sealed baseline, and the skew (+7.6, downside paid) reads like a hedged-long or short book. A squeeze is a mechanism that the options lean does not price. If shorts had covered, days to cover would have fallen as the stock rose, and it rose instead.
findings.independence: Curved Trading/FINRA 2026-09-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/tgtx/short-interest/, snippet_only, 403 on fetch). Both are FINRA data, so they are one underlying source.

findings.finding: The stock goes into the print near a 52-week high, having more than doubled year to date (Stocktwits 2026-10-30) and risen ~20% since the Q2 print. It carries an unconfirmed Betaville 'uncooked' takeover rumour from 2026-08-21 ($20-40bn US biopharma suitor) and the positive 2026-10-23 azer-cel progressive-MS Phase 1 data (26 patients, no high-grade CAR-T toxicity). A Q3 that only meets the bar has less room.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 came after a strong run and fell 11.3%. The Q3 2025 print came after a run and fell 3.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the run-up itself is the pricing. This is filed for completeness because it raises the bar on a soft print. If the M&A hope were priced out, the stock would not be within 3% of its high.
findings.independence: Stocktwits 2026-10-30 (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/tgtx-stock-hits-fresh-52-week-high-ahead-of-earnings-amid-buyout-buzz/cZULRP2R9cR) on the rally and sentiment. The finviz 2026-11-02 preview says the setup 'leaves less room for a soft print'.

findings.finding: Class demand held up in Q3. Novartis reported Kesimpta (the competing anti-CD20) Q3 2026 sales of $1,484m, +22% cc, with 'continued strong momentum ... driven by increased demand', on 2026-10-27, after TG last spoke. Roche's Ocrevus US 9M 2026 was +5% CER (2026-10-22). Neither shows an anti-CD20 summer slowdown, though Kesimpta's Q3 growth (+22%) is below its 9M rate (+26%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history of peer prints moving TGTX that I could find.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer prints are public, but they do not break out US figures, and BRIUMVI is a share-taker, so the transmission is weak. This is a proxy and is sized small.
findings.independence: Roche 9M update (https://www.roche.com/investors/updates/inv-update-2026-10-22). A different company, so this is independent.

baseline_tension: The slight negatives (bar above the flat signal, EPS opex risk, run-up) agree with the +7.6 downside-paid skew, so they are probably priced. The crowded short (19% of float, 15 days) and the beat-own-guide record cut the other way, which leaves the net near zero and p_up at 49.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 / two readings of one document: merged the draft's 'consensus above flat signal' (-1.0) and 'FY raise forced if Q3 meets consensus' (+1.0) into one revenue finding at -0.3, because they rest on the same Q3 US revenue variable.
Lesson 7: crowded short (~19% of float, 15 days to cover) shrank the negatives: EPS/opex -1.0 to -0.6, run-up/expectations -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 1: the reaction history (beat-and-raise sold in 2 of 4 prints) kept p_up near 50; it moved from 48 to 49 as the negatives shrank.
Lesson 5: the Kesimpta/Ocrevus proxy stays small at +0.3; unchanged.
Lesson 6: the bar is verified by two agreeing estimate sources; no cap needed.
